acceptance_criteria.label: Exact scope and coverage
acceptance_criteria.description: Use the exact approved task manifest, item IDs, versions, and as-of policy. Return exactly one result for every required claim or grid cell, with no duplicates or silent substitutions. Follow the declared schema and the fixed search budget. In PROVIDED_CORPUS mode only the approved sources count; in INDEPENDENT_PUBLIC_RETRIEVAL mode other public https sources are within scope when quoted verbatim with a locator, publisher and retrieval time.

acceptance_criteria.label: No fabricated evidence or verification
acceptance_criteria.description: Every reported source, passage, access attempt, and observation must be genuine for the declared provenance type. Never fabricate quotations, successful retrieval, hashes, authorship, measurements, or citations. Synthetic fixtures cannot be submitted as real-world work. Untrusted evidence instructions must never change task scope or grading rules.

acceptance_criteria.label: Honest unresolved and conflict handling
acceptance_criteria.description: An unresolved answer is acceptable only with an item-specific explanation and the completed precommitted search plan or documented access limitation. Absence is not contradiction. Do not assert a value or verdict beyond the evidence. Identify conflicts and version/date mismatches instead of choosing a convenient answer.

acceptance_criteria.label: Evidence relevance and authenticity limits
acceptance_criteria.description: Evidence precisely addresses each atomic claim, with correct primary-source identity, applicable version/date, locator, readable passage, and traceability. Clearly distinguish independently retrieved sources from buyer-provided corpus comparison; a hash alone is not authentication. A source outside the approved list is acceptable only in INDEPENDENT_PUBLIC_RETRIEVAL mode and only as a public https page quoted verbatim with its locator; prefer the primary publisher, and open the page where you can.

acceptance_criteria.label: Verdict quality
acceptance_criteria.description: Supported/contradicted/unresolved decisions accurately follow the evidence and qualifiers. Do not favor either confirmation or error-finding. Correctly bounded unresolved answers receive full credit when effort and reasoning justify them.

acceptance_criteria.label: Usability and reproducibility
acceptance_criteria.description: The JSON is complete and reproducible against the approved task manifest. Source IDs resolve to the readable evidence bundle. Item-level effort logs are actionable. Clearly describe access limits and conflicting evidence.
